old: Stammering affects approximately 1% of adults worldwide. In the UK, NHS waiting lists for speech and language therapy routinely exceed 12 months — and most programmes offer only infrequent, brief sessions. Between appointments, there is almost nothing evidence-based to practice with. Flowen fills that gap: daily, structured practice with real-time feedback, available from day one.

CLINICAL ENGINEERING
Built for Precision, Not Approximation
Every layer of the Flowen stack is optimised for the sub-100ms round-trip required to deliver effective biofeedback during live speech.
new: The browser analyses microphone audio to display live feedback. Timing and signal quality depend on your device, browser and environment; no end-to-end latency guarantee is published.

old: We detect the exact moment you begin speaking so we can tell you immediately whether your onset was gentle or tense. Amplitude, fundamental frequency, and a jitter/shimmer-based vocal tension index are all measured and streamed in real time.
new: Microphone audio drives visual cues based on acoustic features such as amplitude and pitch. These estimates support practice; they are not clinical measurements of vocal tension or a diagnosis.
